detail: Implemented all three requested modules within the trial deadline. record_sort.py provides stable multi-key ordering with direction-aware comparisons and null-last handling; table_render.py validates, truncates, aligns, and renders exact ASCII tables; glob_match.py parses and matches literals, escapes, stars, question marks, and character classes without regex. Verified with uv compilation, focused contract assertions, and exhaustive core glob checks.
